civ_a.name: Heirframe · Civilian Robot A
civ_a.instruct: A polite woman with a soft, sweet, overly pleasant voice. Gentle and airy, smiling while she speaks, with an eerie calm and a perfectly even tone, like a contented android who has never had a bad day.
civ_a.ref: Oh, good afternoon! Isn't the light lovely today? I do hope you're having a wonderful, wonderful time. Everyone is.

civ_b.name: Heirframe · Civilian Robot B
civ_b.instruct: A polite middle-aged man with a mild, precise, neutral voice. Courteous and a little stiff, speaking with unsettling serenity, every sentence delivered at the same gentle pace, like a well-mannered service robot.
civ_b.ref: Greetings, citizen. I have completed my tasks for the morning, and I am very content. The Founders provide, and we are grateful.

security.name: Heirframe · Security Robot
security.instruct: A deep, flat, authoritative male voice. Cold, clipped and emotionless, commanding and precise, like an armoured security robot issuing orders.
security.ref: Citizen, halt. You are in a restricted zone. Remain where you are and prepare to be scanned. Resistance will be noted.

enforcer.name: Heirframe · Enforcer
enforcer.instruct: A huge man with a very deep bass voice, gravelly and booming, extremely low pitched and menacing. Slow, confident and mocking, a heavy brute who enjoys the fight.
enforcer.ref: Well, well. A little rental robot, all alone in my district. You picked the wrong street, friend. Let's see what you're made of.
